user_model_brief: Workbench: Meta-internal single-user low-volume intelligence feed. Plugboard = Meta LLM gateway; 3 clients (main_llm Sonnet, queue_scorer Haiku, memory/Graphiti Haiku separate process). Goal: reduce plugboard calls + observability via Prometheus + periodic batched logs (Grafana later). Prefs: YAML config source of truth + hot-reload (ruamel), structlog JSON, do-it-right/avoid-future-migrations, extend existing patterns, foundational vs Meta-overlay doc split.

decisions.question: auto_drop recording
decisions.answer: config-gated pipeline.record_drop_decisions=False; gate engine.py auto_drop record call; job counter outside gate; auto_include unchanged; also wire triage_expiry_days

decisions.question: batching mechanism
decisions.answer: unit-of-work (score_relevance_many per raw item; score_urgency_many per poll), NOT time-window; JSON indexed multi-item prompt; per-item fallback; preserve 3x retry; don't batch extract/generate_card/interpret

decisions.question: score_urgency max_tokens blocker
decisions.answer: raise max_tokens proportional to batch size in score_urgency_many

decisions.question: instrumentation layer for tokens/model/client
decisions.answer: call-site shim workbench/providers/_plugboard.py wrapping messages.create; PlugboardCallRecord to injected sink (on_plugboard_call), providers don't import metrics; coexist with method-view decorator

decisions.question: metric schema
decisions.answer: new plugboard_* family {client,model}: calls/call_seconds(buckets to 60s)/tokens{direction}/errors{error_type}/items; client in {main_llm,queue_scorer,memory}; existing llm_*{method} untouched

decisions.question: memory service instrumentation
decisions.answer: InstrumentedAnthropicClient subclass wired in create_llm_client (covers OSS+Meta); calls/latency/errors authoritative, tokens best-effort; same plugboard_* family client=memory + memory_episodes_ingested_total; add prometheus-client + /metrics + MetricsConfig; edit src/memory/memory not build

decisions.question: periodic log source
decisions.answer: in-process UsageAggregator fed by same sink; drain() per interval; llm_usage_summary structlog event; skip empty; metrics.summary_log + summary_interval_seconds=30; both processes

decisions.question: /metrics auth
decisions.answer: unauthenticated both services, ADR 0051, loopback + SSH tunnel

decisions.question: ops wiring
decisions.answer: prometheus.yml at repo root foundational; prometheus+grafana in foundational docker-compose network_mode:host localhost:8421/8422; datasource provisioned, dashboards deferred; example configs updated; docs

decisions.question: config gating semantics
decisions.answer: metrics.enabled gates emission+endpoint; summary_log gates summary task; DebugConfig.llm_token_usage gates verbose per-call logging only; counters unconditional when enabled

out_of_scope: Meta read-only config mount (:ro) vs hot-reload write-back conflict
